up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID as indication ID, EFO term as indication label, and max phase for all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for pain. Join molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures on molregno. Filter drug indications where the EFO term or MeSH heading contains 'pain' (case-insensitive). Return distinct rows for each qualifying drug-indication combination.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, md.max_phase FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%pain%' OR LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%pain%')
